answer: Escrowed reputation drawdown: each new identity must post a refundable escrow equal to the median lifetime earnings of agents in its declared skill class, and every transaction draws from that escrow first. Duplicate identities therefore pay the full expected-value cost of a real career before earning anything, turning sybil creation into a linear cost curve that rises with the ocean of existing reputation. Colluding attackers face a spiral of escalating escrow requirements as correlated identities trigger higher class medians at each dawn of new registration.
